The selection caps and phase limits must stay in line with the selection script.

terms.meaning: the match situation a fan sees before answering, with no result information
the time after which nothing about the decision is revealed
a curated decision question taken from real match data
a maximum number of questions allowed from one season, phase, team or answer

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the file and compression tools, the test tools, the contract check, the chase sample builder, the option threshold, the CSV reader, and the selection caps.
sections.why: Gives the tests what they need to load and check the moments.

sections.name: Moment, matches
sections.title: Moment record shape and match loader
sections.what: Describes one moment, with its id, match, season, cutoff, leverage, pre-lock state, decision options and reveal. Loads the moment file and the match table into a lookup.
sections.why: The checks need the stored shape to test it.
sections.watch_out: Field names must match the saved file exactly.

sections.name: rowsOf
sections.title: Ball row grouping
sections.what: Reads the ball table and keeps only rows for matches in the moment set, grouped by match.
sections.why: Lets each moment be compared with the balls of its own match.
sections.watch_out: Reads the whole ball table into memory, which is acceptable at this size.

sections.name: fifty golden moments (moments) (part 1)
sections.title: Fifty moments: selection and data checks
sections.what: Checks the count of fifty, one moment per match, and the seasons 2024 to 2026. Checks the caps and the leverage threshold. Checks the decision options and their provisional labels, and that no fixed answer or phase rule is right more than the allowed share. Checks that each match passes the contract, that the pre-lock state matches the ball data, and that the reveal matches the real winner.
sections.why: Likely reason: prevents a biased, repetitive or leaking question bank.
sections.watch_out: The 40 and 70 percent limits are the main guard against trivial questions. Loosening them weakens the bank.

sections.name: fifty golden moments (moments): for
sections.title: Cutoff and hidden-result checks
sections.what: Checks that the overs label is consistent with the balls left, that the cutoff falls after the match start, and that the pre-lock state has no result fields. Checks that the pre-lock state matches the deliveries before the cutoff and that the next delivery is legal.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops the question from revealing the answer before the cutoff.
sections.watch_out: The cutoff is calculated in 30-second steps. A change in that step breaks the match.

summary: Checks the saved set of fifty golden moments from IPL seasons 2024 to 2026: their variety, leverage, decision data, pre-lock state against ball-by-ball data, and that the cutoff hides the result.
purpose: Makes sure the question bank shown to fans is real, balanced, reproducible, and does not reveal the answer early.
why: Likely reason: a question bank that leaks the answer or repeats one pattern would make the product's grades meaningless.
how: Loads the golden moments file and the match and ball data. Checks the hash, the count of fifty, the caps by season, phase, team and answer, the leverage threshold and options, the provisional labels, and the phase rule. Rebuilds each pre-lock state from the ball data and checks that it matches, that the cutoff is after the start, and that the next delivery is legal.
outputs: Pass or fail. Failures name the moment id.
risks: This is a large test that reads compressed data. Its caps come from the selection script, so changing that script can break it. The answer and phase limits are the main guard against trivial questions.
debug: For a failed moment, use its id to find it. Compare its pre-lock fields with the ball rows up to its cutoff.
